name: Aqua
source:
The illegitimate daughter of Arin and a mercenary, and victim of Herriam's sexual revenge. This sordid existence yields a favorable position as leader of the harem, but as always, she is the target of his other lovers' envy...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE080645.html]DLsite English[/url]]
